title: System Collapse
author: Martha Wells
summary: The newest Murderbot novel. The sardonic security android who has freed itself from its makers is back with its crew on a colony world, facing a dangerous threat while its own anxieties act up.
readIf: you already love Murderbot and want another dose of its anxious, funny inner voice.
skipIf: you are new to the series, as this installment leans on earlier stories.

pairings.reason: The first Murderbot story, if you want to start at the beginning before this one.
Another story told by an artificial mind, though more formal and politically heavy.
A softer, more reflective story about a robot and a person learning to understand one another.
